CODE
5.240. 
Default interest
Without prejudice to the recovery of extrajudicial recovery costs, the compensation due for delay in the performance of an obligation to pay a sum consists exclusively of interest at the legal rate, subject to the exceptions provided for by law or contract.
This default interest is payable without the creditor being required to prove the existence or extent of the loss.
It is due from the date of the formal notice, except in cases where the law or the contract provides for it to accrue automatically.
In the event of intentional fault on the part of the debtor, compensation may exceed interest at the legal rate.
